expect.d: A new private school in Asheville for neurodivergent students, first day 20 AUGUST 2026, enrolling now. Every student gets a 1:1 behaviour technician and an individual learning plan built by special education consultants and BCBAs. Learning is built around movement, sensory activity and games rather than desk work. Term dates published: parent reviews 6 Nov 2026 and 5 Feb 2027, breaks 23-27 Nov and 21 Dec to 1 Jan, spring break 5-9 Apr 2027, last day 11 Jun 2027. Email info@campfireaba.com to ask about enrolment. No street address, grade range, class size or tuition figure is published anywhere on their site. Ask for all four in writing.
